data.one_liner: A light-weight emoji package for Flutter and Dart applications with up-to-date emojis.
data.what_it_does: Provides classes like Emoji and EmojiParser to handle, parse, emojify, and unemojify text containing emojis. It supports both local dataset initialization and fetching the latest emoji data from a server.
use_when: You need to convert shortcode strings (like :coffee:) into actual emojis.
You need to parse, count, or replace emojis within strings in Dart or Flutter applications.
avoid_when: You need complex UI widgets like a full-featured emoji picker keyboard.
strengths: Supports null safety and all platforms supported by Dart.
Handles grapheme clusters and glyphs properly using the characters library.
Can fetch the latest emoji dataset from a server.
weaknesses: Requires internet permissions on Android if you choose to load datasets from the server.
data.setup_notes: Make sure to add Internet permission in AndroidManifest.xml if you plan to use server-fetched emoji datasets.
